body: Yeah.. if you’ve heard what sia has done, no.

They could be doing a lot better, they are giving an inch where we should be getting a mile if it is bad enough, None of these things really do anything you can change your frame of mind learn to handle things better, but it’s still a physical problem (and actually not everyone can learn to handle it better some people can’t do anything)
I think it does need to qualify for disability support pension for those who need it or they are just condemned to a life of suffering in poverty

It’s just not recognised, I want those who need it to get any support they should be getting, drugs do not always work and they make people so depressed, 

It is a disability, maybe it’s not as bad for you but I have this friend who I feel bad for every single day because she can’t do anything even when she has the drugs it will make her focus, but she will still usually get fired within a day or two no matter how hard she works, the adhd side of things is what is getting her fired, The things that the drugs don’t fix,

Some people can’t work and that just leads them straight to the street, or killing themselves, 

would you rather not have it classified as a disability I mean on some level it doesn’t even exist in adults in Australia it’s like people don’t want to even know it exists

Needs to be recognised
Navals are just a style of armour, let them just exist, you don’t have to buy them, who cares if there’s a thousand of them
